messages:
jamie: Starting RC candidate creation for rc-2026-03-22a. Created branch `release/rc-2026-03-22a`. Need signoffs: DB migration script + release notes + security review. Target promo window 22:00 UTC tonight. Can we lock artifacts?

alan: ack. DB migration reviewed, small index add. Suggest run in dark on canary first. :thumbsup:

linda: release notes: draft at https://docs.internal/release-notes/rc-2026-03-22a — added migration notes and rollback steps.

deploy-bot: rc created: id=rc-2026-03-22a; artifacts pinned: build-7890; smoke image: gcr.io/redwood/smoke:20260322; status=created

sara: who's the oncall sheriff for promo? also we need to pin model-weights v3.2.1 (perf regression guard).

oncall-sheriff: i'm oncall-sheriff. i'll be watching the promo. add me to checklist.

jamie: added. Promotion plan: 1) canary (5% region) 15 min smoke, 2) stagger region ramp (EU->NA->APAC) 3) full traffic. If canary fails, rollback using `deploy-bot rollback --rc rc-2026-03-22a --to build-7889`

alan: confirm KV cache warmup needed, will run kv-warm job during canary. command: ```./scripts/kv_warm.sh --targets=canary```

deploy-bot: canary job scheduled. canary-window=15m; region=eu-west1; traffic=5%

sara: QA: post-canary sanity list — 1) latency p50 < 120ms 2) error rate < 0.2% 3) embedding job throughput OK. I'll run the first two checks.

linda: security: no new scopes, approved.

jamie: release notes link again: https://docs.internal/release-notes/rc-2026-03-22a — please add any missing bullet points by 19:00 UTC.

oncall-sheriff: logging: ensure dev-extras flag off in prod. If anything spikes, i'll flip traffic to fallback model in 5 mins.

alan: FYI deploy bot will print rollout tokens during promo; watch for `rollout-id` and `sheriff-ack`.

deploy-bot: promo ready command: `deploy-bot promote --rc rc-2026-03-22a --window 22:00-23:00UTC --stagger EU,NA,APAC`

sara: :thumbsup: all good from QA, I'll be in channel during canary.

jamie: final check: QA ok, DB migration ok, security ok. Locking artifacts and requesting final signoff.

linda: :+1: locking docs and artifacts.

alan: :shipit:

oncall-sheriff: I give sheriff signoff. i'll be both monitor and rollback lead.

deploy-bot: promotion scheduled for 22:00 UTC. schedule_id=prom-20260322-001; watchers=[jamie,alan,sara,linda,oncall-sheriff]

jamie: thanks everyone. if we need to abort, use `deploy-bot abort --schedule prom-20260322-001`
